statements.statement: The patient has a history of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The patient reports recurrent episodes of palpitations
The patient reports intermittent dizziness and giddiness
The service was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias
The service was ordered to assess the hemodynamic impact of the valvular disease
The diagnosis codes are I34.0, R00.2, and R42
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial was based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
